w10_T4_006226: A village hall had 209 chairs in its store. A school lent the hall 26 chairs, and a church added 62 more. A wedding party then took 88 chairs away to a marquee. A furniture firm later delivered 55 new chairs to the store. A dozen tables are stacked against the wall. How many chairs are in the store now?
w10_T4_006227: On Monday morning Tara had 15 packets of bulbs in her shed, which is 3 metres wide, and she gave 8 packets to the school garden. In the afternoon she opened the packets that were left, and each packet holds 7 bulbs. That evening a neighbour gave her 26 more bulbs, and the next day a market stall sold her 16 more. She then found that 14 bulbs had rotted and threw them out. Every bulb she planted grew 6 flowers, and Tara ended the summer with more flowers than her friend Meera had. How many flowers did Tara grow?
w10_T4_006229: A dairy records its milk in litres although the churns are still marked in gallons. On Monday morning the dairy had 201 churns standing in the yard. Before lunch 143 churns went out on the rounds, and in the early afternoon 6 churns came back and were refilled. In the evening 24 churns were sent to a cheese maker. Each churn still in the yard holds 7 litres of milk, and a dozen cats live in the barn beside it. How many litres of milk are in the yard?
w10_T4_006237: A brick maker fired 29 racks of bricks, and each rack holds 9 pallets. A yard sale then added 68 pallets to the stock. Every pallet holds 8 bricks. A neighbour gave the maker 52 loose bricks, and a demolition site sent 54 more. A builder then bought 1966 bricks. A dozen wheelbarrows stand in the yard. How many bricks are left?
w10_T4_006240: A cafe counts its baking time in minutes and writes it on the board in hours. The cafe had 13 tubs of icing in the fridge. 6 tubs were used for a wedding cake, 2 for cupcakes and 2 more for biscuits. Each tub still in the fridge fills 5 piping bags. The pastry chef then made more icing and tripled the number of piping bags. During the week 35 bags were used up. How many piping bags does the cafe have?
w10_T4_006242: A stadium sells its drinks in millilitres although the cups are printed in litres. The store had 150 pallets of cups, and each pallet holds 4 boxes. Every box holds 7 sleeves of cups. A late delivery added 33 sleeves to the store. Each sleeve holds 5 cups. How many cups are in the store?
w10_T4_006256: On Monday morning a garden centre had 149 sacks of bulbs, and a grower delivered 77 more before lunch. In the afternoon a second grower brought 58 sacks. In the evening every sack was opened, and each one holds 7 bulbs. On Tuesday 439 bulbs were sold and a customer returned 26. Ines sold more bulbs that week than her colleague Piet did, and a dozen robins follow the gardeners around. How many bulbs does the centre have?
w10_T4_006257: A leather workshop records its jobs in minutes and bills them in hours. On Monday morning the store held 66 rolls of leather, and 15 rolls were sent to a bag maker. In the afternoon each remaining roll was cut into 6 panels. In the evening every panel was cut again into 4 straps. A supplier then delivered 39 finished straps. Ida cut more straps that day than her colleague Rolf did. How many straps does the workshop have?
w10_T4_006260: A print shop had 40 boxes of leaflets, and a client delivered 76 more. The manager then ran the presses again and tripled the number of boxes in the shop. Each box holds 9 bundles of leaflets. A campaign used 1599 bundles. The bundles that were left were shared equally among the shop's 3 vans. How many bundles are in one van?
w10_T4_006261: A community centre counts its bookings in minutes and puts them on the wall chart in hours. The centre had 119 mugs in its kitchen, and a donation added 66 more. A street party then borrowed 109 mugs and never brought them back. A charity shop gave the centre 71 mugs, and a cafe donated 74. A dozen teapots sit on the top shelf. How many mugs are in the kitchen?
w10_T4_006266: A bakery counts its proving time in minutes and writes it in the diary in hours. On Monday morning the bakery had 102 crates, and each crate holds 4 loaves. During the afternoon 318 loaves were sold. In the evening a second bake added 10 loaves. The loaves that were left were shared equally among the bakery's 4 shops. How many loaves went to one shop?
w10_T4_006268: Kofi had 53 dollars saved at the start of the month, and a birthday card brought him 65 dollars. He spent 16 dollars on a book and 44 dollars on football boots. A neighbour then paid him 58 dollars for washing cars. He spent 93 dollars having his bicycle repaired and earned 47 dollars from a paper round. Kofi has more money saved than his cousin Ama has, and his bicycle cost 210 dollars when it was new. How many dollars does Kofi have now?
w10_T4_006279: A school kitchen had 117 melons in the store, and a farm delivered 52 more. A summer fair then used 157 melons. The cook put half of the melons that were left into the fridge and stood the rest on the counter. Every melon in the fridge was cut into 2 pieces for the salad bar. The kitchen has 8 fridges. How many pieces of melon are there?
w10_T4_006283: A scout hut had 128 tent pegs in its box. 110 pegs were taken to a camp and lost in the mud. A shop then sold the troop 35 pegs, and a parent donated 21 more. 9 pegs were bent and thrown out. Each peg still in the box is packed with 5 guy ropes for the summer trip. A dozen sleeping bags hang in the hut, and the troop has 40 members. How many guy ropes are packed?
w10_T4_006289: Mira picked 101 apples from her tree. She gave 65 of them to the village fete. Her uncle then brought her 33 apples from his own orchard. She used 65 apples to make chutney, and a neighbour later gave her 60 more. Mira now has more apples than her brother Sami has. How many apples does Mira have?
w10_T4_006290: On Monday morning a stationery depot had 216 boxes of paper. Before lunch 124 boxes were sent out to schools. In the afternoon a mill delivered 68 boxes. In the evening every box in the depot was opened, and each box holds 4 reams. On Tuesday 499 reams were dispatched to an office. How many reams are in the depot?
w10_T4_006292: On Monday morning a nursery had 108 trays of lettuce, and a grower delivered 60 more before lunch. In the afternoon the trays were counted, and each tray holds 7 seedlings. In the evening 275 seedlings were sold at the gate, and the next morning a supermarket took 677. A customer then returned 5 seedlings. Marta sold more seedlings that week than her colleague Bram did. How many seedlings are at the nursery?
w10_T4_006295: A model shop had 47 kits on the shelf, and 8 kits went back to the maker as faulty. A delivery added 32 kits, and a club then bought 27. Each kit still in the shop contains 5 sprues, and every sprue holds 4 plastic pieces. Yara stocks more kits than her rival Tom does, and a dozen model planes hang from the ceiling. How many plastic pieces are in the shop's kits?
w10_T4_006301: A canoe club had 58 paddles in its shed, and a grant paid for 70 more. A flood then damaged 116 paddles beyond repair. The club bought enough paddles to make the number in the shed 2 times as large, and a merger with another club made it 2 times as large again. Each paddle is stored with 7 spare bolts. All of the bolts were shared equally among the shed's 6 tool boxes. The club has 90 members. How many bolts are in one tool box?
w10_T4_006305: A wholesaler had 222 sacks of onions, and a farm delivered 38 more. A restaurant chain then bought 119 sacks. Each sack still in the warehouse holds 9 onions. A grower later dropped off 56 loose onions. Ana holds more sacks than her competitor Luis does, and a dozen forklifts work in the yard. How many onions are in the warehouse?
w10_T4_006307: On Monday morning a hardware store had 187 tins of paint, and a van delivered 9 more before lunch. In the afternoon a second delivery doubled the number of tins in the store. In the evening 327 tins were sold to a decorating firm. On Tuesday a supplier sent 60 tins and a returned order added 50 more. Each tin now in the store fills 8 paint trays. The store has 14 aisles. How many paint trays can the store's tins fill?
w10_T4_006310: A school had 27 boxes of exercise books in its store, and the office tripled that number with a new order. 64 boxes were then handed out to classes. A neighbouring school sent 74 boxes to the same store. Each box still in the store holds 7 exercise books. How many exercise books are in the store?
w10_T4_006311: Nadia had 39 rolls of ribbon in her craft room, and a sale added 44 rolls. 4 rolls were spoiled by damp and thrown away. A friend gave her 10 rolls, and a market stall sold her 39 more. Each roll cuts into 9 lengths for gift wrapping, and a shop then gave her 41 ready-cut lengths. Nadia has more ribbon than her sister Alina has. How many lengths of ribbon does Nadia have?
w10_T4_006315: A leisure centre records its court bookings in minutes and displays them in hours. The centre had 115 tennis balls in its basket, a delivery added 14, and a club donated 39 more. 24 balls were then lost over the hedge. The rest were shared equally among the centre's 4 courts, and the coach took the basket for court one. A member added 17 balls to that basket. Each ball in it is used for 7 practice serves during a drill. How many practice serves does the drill give?
w10_T4_006325: On Monday morning a paper mill had 184 bales of pulp, and 72 bales were sent to another mill. In the afternoon each remaining bale was pressed into 7 rolls, and every roll was cut into 4 reams. In the evening 286 reams were damaged by water, and the next day 2277 reams were sold to a printer. Each ream that is left will be cut into 7 pads of paper. The mill employs 130 people. How many pads of paper will the mill make?
